title: A Go! Go! Cory Carson Summer Camp
overview: Cory's spending the summer at Camp Friendship with his best friend, Freddie. But jealousy flares when Freddie brings his cousin Rosie along for the ride.

title: Baby Einstein Ocean Explorers
overview: Discovering the fascinating flora and fauna of the deep to exploring the secrets of the shoreline, children will delight in joining the SS Curiosity crew to sing, dance, and discover. Created in partnership with child development experts, each episode engages young viewers and reinforces early learning skills through repetition and interactivity as they journey from sea floor to the shore.

title: Brown and Friends
overview: In a cozy little neighborhood coffee shop, a group of fun-loving friends get together — and get up to all kinds of adventures.

title: Dee & Friends in Oz
overview: When a mysterious key transports her to the land of Oz, a regular kid named Dee goes on a musical journey to save magic — and be the hero of the story.

title: Furry Friends Forever: Elmo Gets a Puppy
overview: An upcoming animated Sesame Street special premiering on HBO Max on August 5, 2021. The special serves as an introduction to Tango, Elmo's new pet puppy.

title: Green Eggs and Ham
overview: Guy-Am-I, an inventor, and his friend Sam-I-Am go on a cross-country trip that would test the limits of their friendship. As they learn to try new things, they find out what adventure brings.

title: Learn ABCs with Baby Shark
overview: Join Baby Shark and his animal friends to learn about your ABCs, counting numbers and using different colors with catchy songs and games.

title: LEGO Friends: Girls on a Mission
overview: Meet Andrea, Mia, Emma, Olivia and Stephanie. They're five best friends. And they're on a heroic mission: to save Heartlake City from wily swindlers.

title: L.O.L. Surprise! House of Surprises
overview: Calling all queens. Royal Bee is bringing her BFF's to The House of Surprises to show them her FABULOUS new project.

title: Mighty Bheem's Playtime
overview: Bheem, a fun-loving toddler with incredible strength, is heading to school. Join his classroom adventures as he makes new friends and plenty of mischief!

title: Mighty Express: Mighty Trains Race
overview: Trouble on the tracks! Freight Nate gets tricked into participating in a high-speed race — with all the Mighty Express cargo cars at stake!

title: Mighty Express: Train Trouble
overview: A sneaky duo has tricked the trains and taken over Mission Station! Can Flicker flex his skills on the tracks to rescue his friends and save the day?

title: My Sesame Street Friends
overview: Join your favorite Sesame Street friends as they discover the magic of learning and explore an exciting range of topics, from animals and superheroes, to theater, music, transportation, and much, much more!

title: Not Quite Narwhal
overview: Curious little Kelp's been living his whole life as a narwhal... until he finds out he's actually a unicorn. Now he's got two worlds to explore!

title: Oggy Oggy
overview: Join adorable kitten Oggy and his cast of cat pals in a bright and colorful kitty world. They're always on the go for fun times and fantastic adventures!

title: Phantom Pups
overview: A young boy and his family move into a haunted home, where he meets three adorable ghost pups and tries to help them turn back into real dogs.

title: Pokémon Horizons
overview: Follow Liko and Roy as they unravel the mysteries that surround them and encounter Friede, Captain Pikachu, Amethio, and others during their exciting adventures!

title: Pororo the Little Penguin
overview: Fun adventures await in the forest named Porong Porong Village where Pororo and friends live. New friends show up in the village and many exciting things happen in the forest. Our playful little gentoo penguin Pororo, naughty spinosaurus Crong, sweet and lovely American beaver Loopy, cheerful and sporty Adélie penguin girl Petty, clever fennec fox Eddy, strong minikaniko Rody, trustworthy polar bear Poby, happy-go-lucky hummingbird Harry, magical dragon wizard Tong-Tong, and a red sedan car Tu-Tu live in this snow-covered wonderland.

title: Scaredy Cats
overview: On Willa Ward’s twelfth birthday, she inherits a beautiful charm necklace that belonged to her mother, who was a witch.  She soon learns 2 bad witches, Wilma and Wanda are after her locket so they can have ultimate power, and she alongside her best friends Scout and Lily turn into cats to escape.

title: Sea of Love
overview: Sea animal friends Bruda, Bobbi, Wayu and Puri go on mini adventures in the ocean, where relatable, everyday moments come with a splash of magic.

title: Storm on Sesame Street
overview: In the Storm on Sesame Street special, Elmo and his friends work together to get ready for a big storm, learning how to be prepared, have courage, and calm their bodies and minds when things feel scary. After the storm passes, Sesame Street looks different, and everyone pitches in to help their neighbors rebuild their homes. With the help of the neighborhood, including celebrity guests Post Malone and Michelle Buteau, Elmo and Abby set out to make a difference, and discover that small acts of kindness, and support from friends, can make the biggest difference of all.

title: StoryBots: Answer Time
overview: Got a question? The StoryBots have an answer! Join curious friends Beep, Boop, Bing, Bang and Bo on fun adventures to find facts for real kids like you.

title: Strawberry Shortcake: Berry in the Big City
overview: Aspiring baker Strawberry Shortcake arrives in Big Apple City to get her big break — and have flan-tastic adventures with her new berry besties!

title: Super Monsters
overview: Preschool kids whose parents are the world's most famous monsters try to master their special powers while preparing for kindergarten.

title: Super PupZ
overview: Four pups with superpowers team up to help their new friends and a furry alien comrade in this cuddly, cosmic adventure.

title: Superhero Baby Shark
overview: Baby Shark and Daddy Shark are superheroes! They use their skills, tools and teamwork to protect the town from the evil villain, Thief Baby Shark.

title: Team Kaylie
overview: After a brush with the law, teen celebrity Kaylie Konrad swaps social stardom for court-ordered chaos as a middle school wilderness club leader.

title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
overview: Ten-year-old Hazel Wells has just moved to the big city of Dimmadelphia because of her dad’s new job. On top of being in an unfamiliar environment, it’s the first time she’s been without her brother, Antony, who’s just left for college, leaving her lonely and unsure of herself. All that changes when the pink-and-green-haired neighbors next door reveal that they are no ordinary neighbors…they’re Cosmo and Wanda, fairy godparents! And they’re coming out of retirement to make all of Hazel’s wishes come true.

title: Titipo Titipo
overview: Titipo the train is out to prove that he's got what it takes to help the folks of Train Village ride the rails safely and reliably.

title: Word Party Presents: Math!
overview: Count numbers, compare shapes, and find patterns with baby animals Franny, Bailey, Kip, Lulu, and Tilly as they use math and songs to solve problems.

title: Word Party Songs
overview: Sing along and dance with Bailey, Franny, Kip, Lulu and Tilly in this collection of music videos that will get you in the mood to move and groove!
